algorithm.dtype: float64; preserve existing float32 inference rounded values stored exactly as float64
algorithm.serialization: float64.hex/fromhex; +infinity as {kind:positive_infinity}; no JSON nonfinite numeric literals
algorithm.label_boundary: test set generation function accepts only p and q, never y
algorithm.input_contract: Only RF-native float32 probabilities losslessly stored in float64 are admitted; validate exact float32 roundtrip without modifying probabilities. Nonconforming values stop execution. Entire source calibration verified. Future pilot validates target chunks before scores/sets.

metrics.prediction_set_coverage: sum(1[y in C])/N; overall and separately true Benign/Attack
metrics.four_set_counts: For {}, {Benign}, {Attack}, {Benign,Attack}: N, Raw correct count, Raw error count, Raw error/N_set
metrics.accepted_confusion: TN/FP/FN/TP using unique label of singleton as accepted prediction
metrics.stratification: overall, true Benign/Attack, frozen original attack_code taxonomy (including ToN scanning), and four chronological segments
metrics.zero_denominators: JSON null + NA reason; CSV NA; counts 0 when appropriate, rates never zero merely because denominator is zero

time.threshold: same frozen source q in all segments

optional_amendment_before_pilot.source_reason: 23 complete windows plus existing 5424-row tail; consecutive groups: 10 windows,10 windows,3 windows+tail; below minimum 20, therefore no source CI
optional_amendment_before_pilot.sampling: draw B block indices with replacement B times per replicate, keep whole blocks; pool counts and recompute denominators
optional_amendment_before_pilot.CI: 95% percentile, NumPy quantile(method=linear) for bootstrap estimates ONLY, never for conformal q; exclude undefined replicates and report valid count
optional_amendment_before_pilot.sharing: same ToN matrix for all metrics/methods at identical scope; no C1 shrunken-scope matrix
optional_amendment_before_pilot.target_minus_source: descriptive difference; no source/target independent or paired CI claimed
